title: Vocabulary: Hobbies & Entertainment
objective: Free-time vocabulary for Speaking Part 1 and personal-interest articles.

items.meaning: things someone collects as a hobby
items.example: He has a huge collection of old coins.

items.meaning: something you play music with (piano, guitar…)
items.example: She's learning to play a string instrument.

items.meaning: when someone sings, acts or plays for an audience
items.example: The band gave an amazing performance.
The audience clapped for ten minutes.

items.meaning: an event where people try to win
items.example: She won first prize in the drawing competition.
items.exampleZh: 她在绘画比赛中得了一等奖。

items.meaning: a public show of art or objects
items.example: There's a photography exhibition at the library.

items.meaning: someone who does an activity for pleasure, not money
items.example: He's an amateur but he paints beautifully.
items.exampleZh: 他是业余的，但画得很美。

items.meaning: free time when you can relax
items.example: What do you do in your leisure time?

items.meaning: to spend relaxed time with friends
items.example: We usually hang out at the skate park.

items.meaning: an activity that you enjoy in your free time
items.example: Reading comics is my favourite pastime.
items.exampleZh: 看漫画是我最喜欢的消遣。

items.meaning: to relax completely, especially after working hard
items.example: After exams, we chilled out at home.
items.exampleZh: 考试后我们在家好好放松了一下。

items.meaning: free time when you are not working or studying
items.example: In my spare time I take photos of birds.
items.exampleZh: 空闲时我会拍摄鸟类照片。

items.meaning: to take part in an activity with other people
items.example: Everyone joined in the singing at the party.
items.exampleZh: 聚会上大家都跟着一起唱歌。

items.meaning: living in a tent for a holiday
items.example: We go camping in the mountains every summer.
items.exampleZh: 每年夏天我们都去山里露营。

items.meaning: a group of people who meet to do an activity together
items.example: She joined the photography club at school.
items.exampleZh: 她加入了学校的摄影社团。

keyPoints: Learn each word with its example sentence — context is what PET tests.
Say the word aloud, then use it in your own sentence about your life.
Review these words in the flashcard system until they reach mastered.
